mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_pay_task (order_id, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, finish_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{state}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{finishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, state, retry_count, next_retry_at, finish_time, create_time, update_time FROM wallet_pay_task WHERE state = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_pay_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW())
UPDATE wallet_pay_task SET state = 1, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND state <> 1
UPDATE wallet_pay_task SET state = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 0
